reason: This plugin is primarily a UI/workspace navigation utility for DeepSeek Harness, adding inline color-and-label controls to sidebar three-dot menus for workspaces and sessions, with local metadata persistence and optional host fallback, and no declared third-party service integration.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 的侧边栏工作区/会话菜单中直接提供颜色与标签管理，并支持打开工作区与复制路径。
summaries.en: This plugin provides inline color and label management in DeepSeek Harness sidebar workspace and session menus, and includes open-workspace and copy-path actions.

capabilities: Injects and extends sidebar workspace/session menu actions in the DSH web interface
Stores workspace/session label metadata locally via host file path and localStorage fallback
Invokes DSH host-side and browser APIs for workspace operations such as opening and path copy

reasons.code: README documents menu-level actions for workspace/session color and label management in the sidebar.
README states local persistence at ~/.dsh/workspace-labels.json with localStorage fallback when host routing is unavailable.
Package configuration declares a web client plugin bundle with injected DSH client runtime/connection modules.
